text:
alex chen: Quick sync — I'm drafting a PRD for retention tiering in the Console. Primary goals: let customers choose retention tiers per-org, surface cost impact in UI, and ensure deletion/GDPR proofs. Need input on scope and launch criteria.
maria gonzalez: High level ok. We need clear acceptance criteria: enforcement (no gaps), audit log of changes, export path for long-term storage, and rollback story.
kevin patel: Customer ask: Acme wants 12mo per-tenant retention + occasional full exports. This will bump storage by ~3x for their org. We should include billing tier mapping.
sophia li: From infra: cross-region retention is tricky because backups live in regional buckets. We need policy: retention obeys region of data origin or org-level region override?
jamie (design): UX idea: retention modal with 3 options: Standard (30d), Extended (90/180), Custom (days). Show estimated monthly cost delta live in the modal. Also show GDPR deletion implication copy and confirm flow. Mockups incoming. :eyes:
kevin patel: API sketch for tech spec:
```
PATCH /v1/orgs/:org_id/retention
{
  "tier": "standard|extended|custom",
  "days": 365,
  "region_policy": "origin|org_override",
  "export_on_change": true
}
```
We need idempotency and strict validation.
alex chen: Acceptance criteria proposal (first pass):
1) Console: set/get retention per org, with live cost estimate, and confirmation flow for destructive changes.
2) API: patch/get endpoints, audit log entries for every change.
3) Enforcement: background job will prune data older than retention window within SLA (72h) and log deletion proofs.
4) Exports: support on-demand export to S3 with retention metadata.
5) Compliance: provide deletion proof bundle (manifest + checksums) for customer requests.
6) Rollback: if change increased retention, old data must still be retained; if decreased, deletions start after a safety window (48h) to avoid accidental loss.
maria gonzalez: Edge cases: org with mixed-region data, in-flight writes during prune, and stuck deletes due to permissions. Add acceptance tests for each.
sophia li: Implementation notes: prune job should batch by shard, backoff on S3 5xx, and surface failures in Console health panel. We should also include retention metrics (tokens pruned, bytes freed, errors).
jamie (design): UX edge cases: confirm modal for decreasing retention must show "What will be deleted" sample and alternative: export before decrease. Also add a banner in the org overview when custom retention is active.
kevin patel: Billing integration: map tiers to billing codes. For custom days >365, auto require sales approval flag. That blocks Console change and returns 403 with a helpful message in API.
alex chen: Launch gating checklist idea:
- PRD approved by product + infra + security + billing
- API contract spec reviewed and signed off
- Console mockups & copy reviewed by design
- End-to-end E2E tests for enforcement and export
- Runbook for ops for failed prune runs
- Customer beta with 2 customers (Acme + BetaCo)
- Cost impact projection and quota/caps for GA
maria gonzalez: Security asks: KMS keys for export, audit log immutability, and retention change notifications to security webhooks. Add those to PRD.
sophia li: Ops runbook snippets: include commands to requeue prunes, manual export steps, and escalation matrix. Example: `ctl retention requeue --org org_123 --from 0` for backfills.
kevin patel: Edge case: org requests immediate deletion under GDPR. Flow: validate legal request, stub exports, run high-priority prune then deliver deletion proof. Need SLA for response.
jamie (design): Small UX nit: make the cost estimate use org's actual storage profile (hot/cold distribution) rather than naive per-token calc. I'll add a tooltip explaining assumptions.
alex chen: Next actions: I'll add acceptance criteria & runbook section to the PRD draft and open a PR. Jamie, please attach mockups. Maria, can you add compliance language and SLA numbers? Kevin and Sophia, can you draft API contract and pruning SLA?
maria gonzalez: Will do. Targeting draft PR by EOD Friday.
ops-bot: created doc PR #142: retention-tiering-prd (draft) — reviewers: @maria gonzalez, @kevin patel, @jamie (design).
kevin patel: I'll start API spec tomorrow, adding 2 example responses + error codes.
sophia li: I'll prototype prune job and a canary run in staging, report perf metrics.
jamie (design): Mockups uploading to Figma now -> https://figma.com/file/xxxxx/retention-modal (WIP).
alex chen: Great. We'll reconvene after drafts. :thumbsup:
